correctness.rationale: For any landmark s in a complete multipartite graph and any edge uv, d(s,uv)=0 exactly when s is an endpoint and equals 1 otherwise, because any nonendpoint is adjacent to at least one endpoint. Hence an edge code is precisely the selected endpoint set e intersect S. Injectivity of e -> e intersect S gives the complete classification: with at least three parts the complement T may contain at most one vertex; in the bipartite case a second possibility is exactly two omitted vertices, one from each part. Therefore edim=N-1 for r>=3, edim=N-2 for r=2, with N and n1*n2 bases respectively and enumerator \(z^N+N z^{N-1}+\mathbf 1_{r=2}n_1n_2z^{N-2}\). An independent brute-force distance/code replay through order eight matched this classification for every multipartite type; the actual package verifier at blob e9f2bc7c463d6608e109b7a461857364a661aa6f was also inspected and uses the same exhaustive check through order ten.
risks: The theorem assumes connected complete multipartite graphs of order at least three; degenerate disconnected one-part cases are outside scope.
